analytical_certificate_review.protocol_binding_scope: The prospective protocol bound analytical notes. This final analytical rerun additionally binds the certificate scripts and reports; it does not retroactively add them to the prospective protocol.
analytical_certificate_review.scope: Analytical identities, source bounds, local-cycle thermodynamics and conditional homogeneous/generalist comparisons. Positive NESS current need not be large. No spatial phase, ancestry survival, taxonomic necessity, exploit resistance or organismhood theorem.
